rongmei.title: Jaulo! Pap phung loumei Raguang Na ta

lines: 1. Zaulo! Pap phung loumei Ravguangc Na ta,
Kalvary ching kauhmei rukhou,
Siang loumei thing rukhou khaeng loumei tei;
Akhang thukpui zeihaeng luangkeilou.
Kanloumei Pu pum khou tei rui,
Zeihaeng le dui tei luang patre;
Alungning le muhlou ri o,
Paap khiu thanpui duithuak. [2]
2. Nzianmei dui nthanna luang bam e,
Kanloumei Pu theilou khou rui;
Zingkei gaanpat ai khou tei tat bamni,
Abumaeng kanloumei Pu daeng khou.
3. Thou puni zeihaeng duithuak khou loumei,
Kapap tei gunh suang mphuan ni;
He! Nangpap phuammei tei lou ‘thanlou ni,
Kanloumei Pu rui guang o tu e.
4. Ai rui lung bammei kandi khou ruina,
Nzianmei Guangh kalloumei Pu;
He! Nang Bumaeng Thanmei rui duangh louna,
Nang lun gaimei tei tithailou o.
